chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm narrated from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The free man is not killed in retaliation for the slave; and when the free man kills the slave, he is made to pay his price, and he is given a severe beating.”

key_terms.الْحُرُّ: the free person, as opposed to a slave in the legal ruling
key_terms.بِالْعَبْدِ: for the slave; indicating the victim whose killing does not entail retaliatory execution of the free person here
key_terms.ضَرْبًا شَدِيدًا: a severe beating as punitive discipline
key_terms.غُرِّمَ: he is made financially liable or compelled to pay compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a free man kills a slave in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning retaliation and liability between a free person and a slave. It establishes that qisas is not applied by killing the free man for the slave, but the killer is held financially liable for the slave’s value and is also subjected to severe corporal punishment.
